tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL in the browser and return the page snapshot. Example: {"url":"https://example.com"}

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read the page as lines like [e12] button "Sign in". Use the refs in other browser tools. Example: {"interactive_only":true}

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element. Returns what changed. Example: {"ref":"e12"}

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Replace the text of an input. Example: {"ref":"e5","text":"hello"}

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose an option in a dropdown. Example: {"ref":"e7","value":"blue"}

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key or chord. Example: {"key":"Enter"}

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page (positive dy = down) or an element. Example: {"dy":600}

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for text, a CSS selector, or network idle. Give exactly one. Example: {"text":"Welcome"}

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back one page. Example: {}

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs (current is marked *), or switch with switch_to. Example: {"switch_to":2}

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Save a screenshot and return the file path. Example: {"full_page":true}

tools.name: browser_eval
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page and return the JSON result. Last resort. Example: {"js":"document.title"}

tools.name: desktop_list_apps
tools.description: List visible windows (open apps, programs) with id, pid and title. Example: {}

tools.name: desktop_launch
tools.description: Start, open or run an application, program, document or URI (launch an app, open a file with it) and list windows. This is the way to open apps. Examples: {"executable":"notepad.exe"}, {"executable":"calc.exe"}, a folder in Explorer {"executable":"explorer.exe","args":["C:\\Users"]}. Windows Settings pages are URIs, not programs: {"executable":"ms-settings:display"} (also ms-settings:network, ms-settings:bluetooth, ms-settings:about); never open Explorer for them. Other URI examples: calculator:, ms-clock:. Do not use it for web pages (http/https): use the browser tools for those. Never start an app by typing its name into some window; always launch it with this tool.

tools.name: desktop_get_state
tools.description: Read the UI tree of a window as numbered elements. Use these numbers as index in other desktop tools. Example: {"title":"Notepad"}

tools.name: desktop_click
tools.description: Click a button, link or other element (mouse click). Returns the refreshed UI tree. Example: {"index":12}

tools.name: desktop_type
tools.description: Click an element to focus it, then type text with the keyboard (enter text). Not for starting apps (use desktop_launch). Returns the refreshed UI tree. Example: {"index":5,"text":"hello"}

tools.name: desktop_set_value
tools.description: Replace the value of a text field or combo box. Example: {"index":5,"value":"hello"}

tools.name: desktop_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key or shortcut chord (Enter, Tab, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Shift+N), optionally after focusing an element. Example: {"keys":["ctrl","s"]}

tools.name: desktop_scroll
tools.description: Scroll an element (positive dy = down). Example: {"index":3,"dy":5}

tools.name: desktop_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element to another (moves the real cursor). Example: {"from":3,"to":9}

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read a text file. Optional range picks lines (1-based). Example: {"path":"a.txt","range":{"start":1,"end":40}}

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: List a directory. With glob, walk recursively and match. Example: {"path":".","glob":"**/*.rs"}

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Find text in files under a path (case-insensitive). Example: {"query":"TODO","path":"src"}

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with content. A checkpoint is saved first. Example: {"path":"a.txt","content":"hi"}

tools.name: fs_edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in a file. old must match once unless replace_all. Example: {"path":"a.txt","old":"foo","new":"bar"}

tools.name: fs_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Fails if the target exists unless overwrite. Example: {"from":"a.txt","to":"b.txt"}

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Delete a file or directory (directories need recursive). A checkpoint is saved first. Example: {"path":"old.txt"}

tools.name: checkpoint_list
tools.description: List file checkpoints of a run (default: current run). Example: {}

tools.name: checkpoint_restore
tools.description: Restore files to a checkpoint (from checkpoint_list). Example: {"id":"cp-0192..."}

tools.name: shell_run
tools.description: Run one shell command and return its exit code, stdout and stderr. Example: {"command":"dir","shell":"cmd","timeout":30}

tools.name: script_run
tools.description: Run a short JavaScript program that calls several tools and returns one compact result. Use await tools.call(name, input) and return a value. Example: {"code":"const r = await tools.call('fs_list',{path:'.'}); return r;"}

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Give 2-5 short options when possible. Example: {"question":"Which file?","options":["a.txt","b.txt"]}

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Replace your plan list. Keep at most one item in_progress. Example: {"items":[{"content":"Open site","status":"in_progress"}]}

tools.name: skill_list
tools.description: List available skills (name, description, version, source, extra files). Example: {}

tools.name: skill_read
tools.description: Load a skill's instructions, or one of its extra files. Example: {"name":"custom-dropdowns"}

tools.name: skill_write
tools.description:
Save a learned skill to your own skills folder. Content is a full SKILL.md: frontmatter (name, description, optional version and when: domains/apps/keywords) plus markdown body. Example: {"name":"my-site","content":"---
name: my-site
description: How to use my-site
---
Steps..."}

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description: Replay a saved workflow (a recorded, parameterised sequence of desktop/browser/tool steps) without calling a model. If the screen differs from the recording it stops and reports the step to continue from. Use workflow_list to see saved workflows. Example: {"name":"notepad_note","params":{"text":"hello"}}

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: List saved workflows with their parameters. Example: {}

tools.name: mcp:gmail/search_emails
tools.description: Search the mailbox for messages matching a query and return sender, subject and date

tools.name: mcp:gmail/draft_email
tools.description: Create an e-mail draft in the mailbox without sending it

tools.name: mcp:gmail/send_email
tools.description: Send an e-mail to one or more recipients immediately

tools.name: mcp:gdrive/read_document
tools.description: Read the contents of a document stored in the cloud drive

tools.name: mcp:gdrive/delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document from the cloud drive

tools.name: mcp:github/list_issues
tools.description: List the open issues of a repository

tools.name: mcp:github/create_issue
tools.description: Open a new issue in a repository

tools.name: mcp:github/get_pull_request
tools.description: Get the title, description, diff and review status of a pull request

tools.name: mcp:github/merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request into its base branch

tools.name: mcp:db/run_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the database and return the rows

tools.name: mcp:db/drop_table
tools.description: Drop a table from the database, removing all of its data

tools.name: mcp:calendar/list_events
tools.description: List the events scheduled in a time range on the calendar

tools.name: mcp:calendar/create_event
tools.description: Schedule a new meeting on the calendar and invite attendees

tools.name: mcp:calendar/delete_event
tools.description: Cancel and remove an event from the calendar

tools.name: mcp:slack/read_channel
tools.description: Read the recent messages of a Slack channel

tools.name: mcp:slack/post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel

tools.name: mcp:weather/get_forecast
tools.description: Weather forecast and temperature for a city for the next days

tools.name: mcp:notion/get_page
tools.description: Fetch the content of a Notion page

tools.name: mcp:notion/archive_page
tools.description: Archive a Notion page so it no longer appears in the workspace

tools.name: mcp:stripe/list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices with their amount and payment status

tools.name: mcp:stripe/refund_payment
tools.description: Refund a payment back to the customer's card
